# 3D Purrtocol

> First implemented 3D Purrtocol artifact and its recovery-state semantic contract.

Current status:
- PKE-106 concept has been promoted via implemented event PKE-033.
- Runtime GLB exists and is CI-validated.
- First Light is intentionally tiny/voxel-like and is not the final art target.
- Visualization is not evidence of any production architecture.

## Runtime

- [3D First Light Markdown](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-3d/index.md): Measurements, semantics, and next frontier.
- [Interactive 3D preview](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-3d/): Human viewer with animation controls.
- [GLB asset](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/assets/purrtocol/purrtocol.glb): Portable glTF 2.0 binary.
- [3D contract](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/data/purrtocol_3d_contract.json): Required node/animation names and First Light hash.
- [Design Bible](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/docs/purrtocol-design-bible.md): Canonical character semantics.

## Lineage

- [Variant Foundry](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-variant-foundry/index.md): Fork and derivative protocol.
- [Canonical variant registry](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/data/purrtocol_variants.jsonl): PKV-CANONICAL root.
